newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Guerrilla bomb kills SLA militiaman in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Guerrilla bomb kills SLA militiaman in Lebanon.

text.p: One pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army militiaman was killed and two others were seriously wounded in a roadside bomb on Sunday, SLA security sources said.
They said the bomb went off beside an SLA convoy on the road of Tair Harfa in the western sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone. The two wounded were taken to hospitals inside Israel.
In Beirut, a Hizbollah (Party of God) spokesman claimed responsibility for Sunday's attack. Three SLA men have been killed and 12 wounded in guerrilla attacks since the beginning of 1997.
In Jerusalem, the Israeli army confirmed the attack but said the wounded were civilians.
Israel also said in a second incident, in the western sector of the zone, two Lebanese civilians were wounded when a roadside charge went off beside their vehicle.
Hizbollah is fighting Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine miles)-wide occupation zone.
